title: Cii Compliance & Shipping Decarbonization: A Practical Guide for Ship Operators

tables.Why it matters: Voyage-level and leg-level data lets you attribute emissions to specific fixtures, not just fleet averages that hide the outliers.
Forward-looking projection tells you a vessel's likely CII rating before you fix, when you can still change speed, routing, or the ship itself.
A single view across owned and chartered tonnage shows which vessels drag your portfolio toward D and E ratings.
Emissions data sitting beside rates, positions, and vetting means commercial teams act on it instead of exporting it into a separate spreadsheet.
A free or low-cost tool gets used across the desk. An expensive one gets rationed to a few analysts and ignored elsewhere.
